prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: vertical background illustration for Vietnamese Buddhist meditation livestream, portrait 9:16, 1080x1920 composition. A newly designed serene Vietnamese wooden temple interior in soft hand-painted 2.5D illustration. Eye level centered symmetrical camera, warm luminous amber light, carved dark teak columns at edges, warm ivory plaster, restrained lotus ornaments, elegant pendant lanterns. Golden seated Buddha on lotus plinth centered around x50% y33%, altar table and lotus flowers occupy y40-58%; clear unobstructed peaceful sacred focal point. Top 0-13% is restrained dark wooden canopy and negative space for overlaid title. Lower 40% (y60-100%) is EMPTY broad smooth warm honey-colored wooden plank floor in convincing perspective with clean center aisle; no mats or cushions anywhere, no foreground objects. Generous open floor width between columns, brightest around altar, soft warm readable floor. Sophisticated painterly illustration, gentle atmospheric depth, warm bright and dignified, cream and wood brown with antique gold. NO people except Buddha statue, NO worshippers, NO text, NO letters or calligraphy, NO watermarks, NO UI, NO cushions, NO mats, NO glow wash obscuring the altar.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for a canvas game. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of EIGHT equal 384x512 cells. NO grid lines. Every pose must remain fully inside its own cell with empty transparent margin, centered x=192 relative to cell and common foot/ground baseline y=480. Same character, clothing, scale, lighting and camera in all 8 poses. Camera: rear three-quarter view, face only subtly in profile, facing away toward the upper left, never toward viewer. Top row cells left to right: walk cycle contact left leg forward; passing step; contact right leg forward; opposite passing step. Bottom row left to right: standing with hands together preparing to sit; knees bent lowering halfway; kneeling low and folding legs; fully seated cross-legged upright in calm meditation, hands resting together in lap. At final pose bottom contact at y=480, upper body retains same head size as standing. No cushion, furniture, book, background or floor, no duplicate people inside a cell. True transparent alpha all around each pose, no colored matte or checker pattern. Soft hand-painted 2.5D game illustration, natural human proportions, Vietnamese Buddhist temple setting, warm amber key light from upper front left, restrained earthy colors, soft painted shading with fine subtle outlines, dignified peaceful mood. Polished consistent game art, not photorealistic, not chibi, not anime. No text, numbers, logos, labels, watermark, scenery or cast shadows outside the subject. Subject: a Vietnamese adult male lay Buddhist, short neatly cut black hair, lean average build, loose slate blue-gray ao lam tunic and matching trousers, barefoot. Modest plain clothing, distinct youthful adult silhouette.
